question: Find the total revenue (sum of SubTotal) generated across all sales orders.
sql: SELECT SUM(SubTotal) AS TotalRevenue FROM Sales.SalesOrderHeader;

question: Get all sales order details for SalesOrderID 43659.
sql: SELECT SalesOrderID, SalesOrderDetailID, ProductID, OrderQty, UnitPrice, LineTotal FROM Sales.SalesOrderDetail WHERE SalesOrderID = 43659;

question: Find the total freight charges collected for sales orders placed in 2013.
sql: SELECT SUM(Freight) AS TotalFreight FROM Sales.SalesOrderHeader WHERE YEAR(OrderDate) = 2013;

question: List the top 10 sales orders with the highest total amount due.
sql: SELECT TOP 10 SalesOrderID, CustomerID, TotalDue FROM Sales.SalesOrderHeader ORDER BY TotalDue DESC;

question: Find the total quantity of products sold (sum of OrderQty) for ProductID 776.
sql: SELECT SUM(OrderQty) AS TotalUnitsSold FROM Sales.SalesOrderDetail WHERE ProductID = 776;

question: Find the number of online orders vs offline orders placed in the database.
sql: SELECT OnlineOrderFlag, COUNT(*) AS OrderCount FROM Sales.SalesOrderHeader GROUP BY OnlineOrderFlag;

question: Calculate total revenue and average order value for each year based on OrderDate.
sql: SELECT YEAR(OrderDate) AS OrderYear, SUM(SubTotal) AS TotalRevenue, AVG(SubTotal) AS AvgOrderValue FROM Sales.SalesOrderHeader GROUP BY YEAR(OrderDate) ORDER BY OrderYear;

question: Find all sales orders where ShipDate was more than 5 days after OrderDate.
sql: SELECT SalesOrderID, OrderDate, ShipDate, DATEDIFF(day, OrderDate, ShipDate) AS ShippingDelay FROM Sales.SalesOrderHeader WHERE DATEDIFF(day, OrderDate, ShipDate) > 5;

question: Get the top 5 product line items with the highest LineTotal in SalesOrderDetail.
sql: SELECT TOP 5 SalesOrderID, SalesOrderDetailID, ProductID, LineTotal FROM Sales.SalesOrderDetail ORDER BY LineTotal DESC;

question: Calculate the average UnitPriceDiscount applied on line items per SpecialOfferID.
sql: SELECT SpecialOfferID, AVG(UnitPriceDiscount) AS AvgDiscountRate FROM Sales.SalesOrderDetail GROUP BY SpecialOfferID ORDER BY SpecialOfferID;

question: Find total revenue and total line items sold for each order placed by CustomerID 29825.
sql: SELECT h.SalesOrderID, h.OrderDate, h.SubTotal, COUNT(d.SalesOrderDetailID) AS LineItemCount FROM Sales.SalesOrderHeader h JOIN Sales.SalesOrderDetail d ON h.SalesOrderID = d.SalesOrderID WHERE h.CustomerID = 29825 GROUP BY h.SalesOrderID, h.OrderDate, h.SubTotal ORDER BY h.OrderDate;

question: Calculate total tax collected and total freight for each order status code.
sql: SELECT Status, SUM(TaxAmt) AS TotalTax, SUM(Freight) AS TotalFreight FROM Sales.SalesOrderHeader GROUP BY Status ORDER BY Status;

question: Find the total quantity sold and total revenue for ProductID 776 by joining header and detail.
sql: SELECT d.ProductID, SUM(d.OrderQty) AS TotalUnitsSold, SUM(d.LineTotal) AS TotalLineRevenue FROM Sales.SalesOrderDetail d JOIN Sales.SalesOrderHeader h ON d.SalesOrderID = h.SalesOrderID WHERE d.ProductID = 776 GROUP BY d.ProductID;

question: Find orders placed in 2012 where TotalDue exceeded 50000.
sql: SELECT SalesOrderID, CustomerID, OrderDate, TotalDue FROM Sales.SalesOrderHeader WHERE YEAR(OrderDate) = 2012 AND TotalDue > 50000;

question: Count how many sales orders have CarrierTrackingNumber recorded in line details.
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT SalesOrderID) AS TrackedOrdersCount FROM Sales.SalesOrderDetail WHERE CarrierTrackingNumber IS NOT NULL;

question: Calculate the percentage of total due contributed by tax and freight for order 43659.
sql: SELECT SalesOrderID, SubTotal, TaxAmt, Freight, TotalDue, (TaxAmt * 100.0 / NULLIF(TotalDue, 0)) AS TaxPct, (Freight * 100.0 / NULLIF(TotalDue, 0)) AS FreightPct FROM Sales.SalesOrderHeader WHERE SalesOrderID = 43659;

question: Find the average order quantity per product line item across all sales order details.
sql: SELECT AVG(CAST(OrderQty AS float)) AS AvgOrderQty FROM Sales.SalesOrderDetail;

question: Find total online sales vs offline sales per quarter for 2013.
sql: SELECT DATEPART(quarter, OrderDate) AS Quarter, SUM(CASE WHEN OnlineOrderFlag = 1 THEN TotalDue ELSE 0 END) AS OnlineSales, SUM(CASE WHEN OnlineOrderFlag = 0 THEN TotalDue ELSE 0 END) AS OfflineSales FROM Sales.SalesOrderHeader WHERE YEAR(OrderDate) = 2013 GROUP BY DATEPART(quarter, OrderDate) ORDER BY Quarter;

question: Find sales orders with more than 10 product line items.
sql: SELECT SalesOrderID, COUNT(*) AS LineCount FROM Sales.SalesOrderDetail GROUP BY SalesOrderID HAVING COUNT(*) > 10 ORDER BY LineCount DESC;

question: Find the maximum and minimum unit price sold for each ProductID in SalesOrderDetail.

question: Count the number of orders placed by each store customer.

question: Calculate average order TotalDue for individual customers vs store customers.

question: Find sales representatives whose SalesYTD is greater than the average SalesYTD of all sales reps.

question: Calculate monthly sales revenue using a CTE and select months with revenue over 2000000.
sql: WITH MonthlySales AS (SELECT YEAR(OrderDate) AS OrderYear, MONTH(OrderDate) AS OrderMonth, SUM(SubTotal) AS Revenue FROM Sales.SalesOrderHeader GROUP BY YEAR(OrderDate), MONTH(OrderDate)) SELECT OrderYear, OrderMonth, Revenue FROM MonthlySales WHERE Revenue > 2000000 ORDER BY OrderYear, OrderMonth;

question: Calculate the running total of annual sales SubTotal by year using SUM() window function.
